verdict.rationale: A public first-party GitHub repository (Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm) shows the source is published and readable, and free Docker self-hosting is consistent with an open distribution. However, nothing in the evidence names the license or confirms it is an open-source license. Missing for 10: explicit open-source license identification (e.g. MIT/Apache), documentation of the licensing terms, independent corroboration that the full product source is available.
